svg.aria-label: Root locus of K over s(s + 1)(s + 2): branches from 0 and minus 1 break away at minus 0.423 and follow the 60 degree asymptotes from minus 1, crossing the imaginary axis at plus or minus j1.414 when K = 6; the third branch runs left from minus 2
